account.title: Account and risk
account.riskPercentHint: 1-2% per trade is the usual ceiling.
account.riskWarning: Risk per trade is above 2%. A short losing streak would hurt the account badly.
account.smallAccountHint: With a small account the system reduces size and only surfaces higher-grade setups.

watchlist.title: Watchlist
watchlist.subtitle: Only markets on this list are scanned.
watchlist.empty: No markets on the list yet

timeframes.title: Timeframes
timeframes.chainLocked: The 4H → 1H → 15M → 5M chain is mandatory and cannot be changed.
timeframes.chainWhy: So a 5M chart is never read in isolation from the bigger picture.

data.title: Market data
data.subtitle: The system always states what kind of data it is using.
data.forceDemoHint: Use this to explore the system without hitting real APIs.
data.noKeyNotice: No market data API key configured. Markets without a direct feed use demo data and are clearly labelled DEMO.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.noKeyNotice: No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY configured, so explanations are generated directly from the engine. Every number is still correct — the wording is just stiffer.
ai.languageHint: The AI replies in whichever language the app is set to.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Only fires when something actually changed. No spam.

appearance.label: Theme
appearance.hint: Leave it on "System" and it follows your device's light/dark setting.

display.title: Display
display.showConfidenceHint: Turn this off if you would rather that number not influence your decisions.

storage.title: Your data
storage.clearConfirm: This deletes the settings, journal entries and positions stored in this browser. It cannot be undone.

about.title: About
about.whatThisIsBody: It scans for setups and gives you a signal — direction, entry, stop and targets — then shows you every input behind the call.
about.whatThisIsNotBody: Not an automated trading system, it never places an order for you, and it is not financial advice. A signal means the conditions met the criteria, not that the trade will work. You place the trade.
about.howItWorks: All the maths is computed in code, not by a language model. The language model only explains and teaches.

limits.data: Metals and FX fall back to DEMO data unless a market-data API key is configured. Crypto streams live from Binance without a key.
limits.llm: Without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY the explanations come straight from the engine: drier wording, identical numbers.
limits.storage: No database is connected, so the journal and settings live in this browser only.
limits.news: No news feed is wired up. The system will say it has no news data rather than invent any.
limits.realtime: Data is polled, not streamed over WebSocket, so prices can lag your broker slightly.
limits.backtest: Replay training uses whatever real history the provider returns. It is not yet a backtester that persists results.
